qe: Which endocrine gland is universally designated as the 'Master Gland' of the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर की किस अंतःस्रावी ग्रंथि को 'मास्टर ग्रंथि' (Master Gland) कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Pituitary gland (pituitary/hypophysis) ko 'Master Gland' kehte hain kyunki ye apne hormones se baaki endocrine glands ko control karta hai - jaise thyroid ko TSH, adrenal ko ACTH, gonads ko FSH/LH aur growth ke liye GH bhejta hai. Ye brain ke base par, hypothalamus ke neeche ek chhoti se haddi ki gaddi (sella turcica) me hota hai aur do hisson me banta hai (anterior aur posterior). Baaki teen bahut important glands hain par kisi ko 'master' nahi kehte kyunki wo doosre glands ko control nahi karte: Adrenal, Thyroid aur Pancreas. Exam point: 'Master gland = Pituitary (kyunki ye doosri glands ko order deta hai); Hypothalamus iska bhi boss hai'.

qe: Which catecholamine hormone secreted by the adrenal medulla triggers the acute 'Fight or Flight' response?
qh: आपातकालीन स्थिति में 'लड़ो या उड़ो' (Fight or Flight) प्रतिक्रिया को सक्रिय करने वाला हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Adrenal gland ka beech wala hissa (medulla) emergency hormone banata hai - Adrenaline (Epinephrine) aur Noradrenaline - jo 'Fight or Flight' response paida karte hain: heart rate aur BP badhta hai, saans tez hoti hai, pupil failta hai, muscle me glucose (energy) aata hai, taaki insaan ladne ya bhaagne ke liye taiyar ho jaye. Baaki teen sharir ke doosre kaam ke hormones hain: Estrogen (female hormone), Insulin (sugar kam karne wala) aur Thyroxine (metabolism). Exam point: 'Fight or Flight = Adrenaline (Adrenal medulla se)'.

qe: Dietary deficiency of which essential trace mineral causes endemic Goitre (thyroid enlargement)?
qh: आहार में किस खनिज तत्व की कमी से घेंघा (Goitre) रोग होता है, जिसमें गर्दन की थायराइड ग्रंथि फूल जाती है?
e: Concept: Thyroid gland ke hormone (T3, T4) banane ke liye ek trace mineral Iodine ki zaroorat hoti hai. Agar kisi ilaake ke paani-mitti me iodine kam ho aur log namak me iodine (iodized salt) na lein to thyroid gland ko bar-bar badhkar kaam karna padta hai aur wo soojh kar bada ho jata hai - ise endemic Goitre (ghailar) kehte hain; bachchon me iodine ki kami se dimagi vikas ruk jata hai (cretinism). Baaki teen minerals alag kamiyan dete hain: Calcium/Phosphorus haddi, Iron anaemia. Exam point: 'Goitre ke liye Iodine zaroori (iodized salt - National Goitre/Iodine Deficiency programme)'.

qe: Blood glucose homeostasis in the human body is reciprocally regulated by which two pancreatic hormones?
qh: मानव शरीर में रक्त शर्करा (Blood Sugar) के स्तर को परस्पर संतुलित रखने वाले दो हार्मोन कौन से हैं?
e: Concept: Blood me glucose ki maatra sabse strictly control hone wali cheez hai. Isme pancreas ke do hormones ek-ke-ulta kaam karte hain: Insulin (beta cells se) blood sugar ko ghataata hai (cells aur liver me sugar daal deta hai), aur Glucagon (alpha cells se) blood sugar ko badhaata hai (liver ka glycogen todta hai). Bal isi jodi se banta hai - insulin kam ho jaye to diabetes; isi ko 'reciprocal regulation' kehte hain. Baaki teen jodiyan bhoolna nahi: Melatonin (neend), Thyroxine (metabolism), Cortisol (stress) - ye sugar ka balance seedha nahi karte. Exam point: 'Sugar ghataane wala = Insulin; sugar badhane wala = Glucagon'.

qe: Exophthalmic Goitre (Graves' Disease) characterized by protruding eyeballs is caused by:
qh: आँखें बाहर की ओर उभरने वाला एक्सोफ्थैल्मिक घेंघा (ग्रेव्स रोग) किसके कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Graves' Disease (Exophthalmic goitre) me thyroid gland zaroorat se bahut zyada hormone banata hai (hyperthyroidism). Iske lakshan ulta: bahut bhookh fir bhi wazan kam, garam lagna-paseena, dharkan tez, ghabrahat, aankh ubhri hui (exophthalmos/protruding eyeballs) aur gale me ghailar. Baaki teen galat hain: adrenal failure, hypothyroidism (jisme sab slow hota hai - wazan badhna, thand) aur Vitamin A ki kami (ye aankh ke liye hai, goitre nahi). Exam point: 'Protruding eyeballs + ghailar = Graves' disease (hyperthyroidism); ilaaj anti-thyroid dawa/radioiodine'.

qe: Which organ acts as both an 'Exocrine' (digestive enzymes) and 'Endocrine' (hormones) heterocrine gland?
qh: कौन सा अंग बहिःस्रावी और अंतःस्रावी दोनों प्रकार से कार्य करने वाली 'मिश्रित ग्रंथि' (Heterocrine Gland) है?
e: Concept: Pancreas ek 'dual' ya heterocrine gland hai - iska ek hissa bahari (exocrine) hai jo paachak enzymes (lipase, amylase, trypsin) banata hai aur ek duct se aanton me chhodta hai; doosra hissa andar (endocrine) hai - Islets of Langerhans - jo seedha blood me hormones insulin aur glucagon deta hai. Baaki teen glands ek hi tarah ke hain: Gallbladder sirf bile store karta hai (koi hormone nahi), Thyroid endocrine to hai par exocrine nahi, aur Liver ke hormones to bante hain par pancreas jaisa enzyme+hormone combo nahi. Exam point: 'Exocrine + Endocrine dono = Pancreas (LAT enzymes + insulin/glucagon)'.

qe: The hormone 'Melatonin', which sets circadian rhythms and sleep-wake cycles, is synthesized by the:
qh: नींद-जागने के चक्र (Circadian Rhythm) को नियंत्रित करने वाला 'मेलाटोनिन' हार्मोन किस ग्रंथि द्वारा स्रावित होता है?
e: Concept: Brain ke andar, thalmo ke peeche ek chhoti shankaar (pine-cone) jaisi gland hoti hai - Pineal gland - jo Melatonin hormone banati hai. Ye roshni-andhere se signal leti hai, aur raat-andhere me melatonin banata hai, isliye ye body ki 'biologic clock' (circadian rhythm) aur neend-jagne ke cycle ko set karta hai. Baaki teen alag glands hain: Pituitary master gland, Parathyroid calcium, aur Thymus immunity. Exam point: 'Melatonin aur neend/circadian rhythm = Pineal gland (raat me banta hai)'.

qe: Which neurohypophyseal peptide hormone is popularly termed the 'Birth Hormone' and 'Milk-Ejection Hormone'?
qh: प्रसव पीड़ा और स्तनों से दूध के निष्कासन (Milk Ejection) के लिए जिम्मेदार हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Oxytocin ek hormone hai jo posterior pituitary se nikalti hai aur do khaas kaam karta hai: (1) delivery ke waqt uterups ki muscles ko bar-bar sikudne par majboor karta hai (birth hormone), aur (2) doodh pilane ke waqt mammary glands ki naliyon ko dabaakar doodh bahar nikaalta hai (milk-ejection let-down). Yahi 'love hormone' bhi kehte hain (lagaav/attachment me). Baaki teen pregnancy/breast ke cheezon se jude hain par ye kaam nahi karte: Prolactin doodh banata hai (nikalta nahi), Progesterone pregnancy maintain karta hai, Relaxin hai pelvic joints ko dheela karta hai. Exam point: 'Delivery (uterus contraction) + doodh nikalna = Oxytocin; doodh banana = Prolactin'.

qe: Insipidity and polyuria in 'Diabetes Insipidus' is clinically caused by the hyposecretion of:
qh: 'डायबिटीज इन्सिपिडस' (बार-बार पेशाब आना और प्यास लगना) किस हार्मोन की कमी के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Diabetes Insipidus ka naam 'insipid' (fika) isliye hai kyunki isme peshab me sugar nahi hoti par bahut zyada peshab (polyuria) aur pyaas hoti hai. Iska kaaran ADH (Anti-Diuretic Hormone / Vasopressin) ka kam banna hai - ye hormone kidney ko paani rokhne ka order deta hai; ADH kam hone par kidney paani nas kar deti hai, isliye khoon me paani kam (dehydration) aur peshab bahut zyada hota hai. Baaki teen hormones ka sugar/pressure se juda kaam hai: Glucagon (sugar badhana), Insulin (sugar ghataana), Aldosterone (sodium). Exam point: 'ADH (vasopressin) ki kami = Diabetes Insipidus (bahut peshab, sugar normal)'.

qe: The 'Emergency Glands' of the human body that sit like pyramidal caps on the superior poles of the kidneys are the:
qh: गुर्दे (Kidney) के ऊपर टोपी की तरह स्थित 'आपातकालीन ग्रंथियां' कौन सी कहलाती हैं?
e: Concept: Do organs gurda (kidney) ke upar taka ki tarah baithe hote hain - Adrenal Glands (Suprarenal glands) - kyunki ye emergency me adrenalin chhodkar sharir ko taiyar karte hain, isliye inhe 'Emergency Glands' bhi kehte hain. Inka bahari hissa (cortex - cortisol, aldosterone, sex hormones) aur andar (medulla - adrenalin) alag-alag hormone banate hain; adrenal ka kaam BP, salt-water aur stress response sambhalna hai, aur iske bina (Addison's) insaan bahut kamzor ho jata hai. Baaki teen alag glands hain: Thymus (immunity), Testes (male hormone), Parathyroid (calcium). Exam point: 'Kidney ke upar ki topi = Adrenal/Suprarenal gland (emergency gland)'.

qe: Which primary androgenic steroid hormone synthesized by the testicular Leydig cells drives male secondary sexual traits?
qh: पुरुषों में माध्यमिक लैंगिक लक्षणों और दाढ़ी-मूँछ के विकास के लिए जिम्मेदार मुख्य एंड्रोजन हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Testes (anhu) ke andar chhoti-chhoti naliyon ke beech khaas cells hote hain - Leydig cells - jo male hormone Testosterone banate hain. Ye hormone ladke me mardana lakshan banata hai: aawaz bhaari, daadhi-mooch, kad aur muscle badhna, adam's apple, aur sperm banane me madad. Baaki teen alag hain: Progesterone pregnancy ka hormone, Luteinizing Hormone (LH/ICSH) ek pituitary hormone hai jo Leydig cells ko order deta hai (khud male hormone nahi), aur Estrogen female hormone. Exam point: 'Testes ke Leydig cells se = Testosterone (male secondary sexual characters)'.

qe: Excessive post-pubertal hypersecretion of Growth Hormone (GH) in adults after epiphyseal plate fusion results in:
qh: वयस्कों में वृद्धि हार्मोन (GH) के अत्यधिक स्राव से हाथ, पैर और चेहरे की हड्डियों का असामान्य रूप से मोटा होना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Growth Hormone (GH) ka asar haddiyon ki lambai par hota hai - ye haddi ke siro (epiphyseal plates) ko badhkar lamba karta hai. Bachpan me ye plates khuli hoti hain, isliye GH zyada hone par insaan bahut lamba ho jata hai (gigantism); par bade (adult) hone ke baad ye plates band ho jaati hain (fuse), isliye us waqt GH zyada hone par lambai nahi badhti - sirf haath, paanv, jabda, naak aur chehra ki haddiyan moti aur badi hoti hain. Is condition ko Acromegaly kehte hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Gigantism (bachpan me), Cushing's (cortisol), Dwarfism (GH kam). Exam point: 'Adult me GH zyada = Acromegaly (haath-paanv-jabda bada); bachpan me = Gigantism'.

qe: Which of the following is a lipophilic 'Steroid Hormone' derived biochemically from cholesterol?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कोलेस्ट्रॉल से बनने वाला स्टेरॉयड हार्मोन (Steroid Hormone) है?
e: Concept: Hormones do bade groups me aate hain. Steroid hormones (cortisol, aldosterone, estrogen, testosterone, progesterone) cholesterol se bante hain aur fat me ghulne wale (lipophilic) hote hain - isliye ye cell ki membrane me aasani se ghus kar andar receptor par kaam karte hain. Baaki teen steroid nahi hain: Thyrotropin/TSH aur Insulin aur Glucagon protein/peptide hormones hain (inhe cell ke bahari receptor se kaam karna padta hai). Exam point: 'Steroid hormones (cholesterol se) = Cortisol, Aldosterone, Sex hormones; Peptide = Insulin, Glucagon, TSH'.

qe: Water-soluble peptide and protein hormones transmit intracellular signals through cell-surface receptors using which second messenger?
qh: जल में घुलनशील पेप्टाइड हार्मोन कोशिका झिल्ली को पार न कर पाने के कारण किस द्वितीयक संदेशवाहक (Second Messenger) का उपयोग करते हैं?
e: Concept: Peptide/protein hormones (Insulin, Glucagon, ACTH) cell ki membrane me ghus nahi sakte, isliye wo bahar se hi receptor par baithte hain aur andar ek 'messenger' chhod dete hain; sabse common doosra messenger Cyclic AMP (cAMP) hai - ye cell ke andar enzyme activate karke kaam karata hai. Isi tarah calcium (IP3/DAG) jaise doosre messengers bhi hote hain. Baaki teen second messengers nahi hain: Vitamine D3 aur cholesterol derivative to steroid-like hain, aur Thyroglobulin thyroid ka storage protein hai. Exam point: 'Water-soluble (peptide) hormone + cell-surface receptor = cAMP (second messenger)'.

qe: The posterior lobe of the pituitary gland (Neurohypophysis) does not synthesize hormones; it stores and releases:
qh: पीयूष ग्रंथि का पश्च भाग (Neurohypophysis) हार्मोन बनाता नहीं है, बल्कि यह किन दो हार्मोनों का संचय और विमोचन करता है?
e: Concept: Pituitary gland ke do hisse hain: anterior (adenohypophysis) jo khud hormones banata hai (GH, TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH, Prolactin), aur posterior (neurohypophysis) jo khud kuch nahi banata - wo hypothalamus me bane hormones ko 'store' karke release karta hai. Ye do hormones hain: Oxytocin aur Vasopressin (ADH). Baaki teen lists anterior pituitary ke hormones ki hain (FSH, LH, Prolactin, GH, TSH, ACTH). Exam point: 'Posterior pituitary sirf store/release karta hai: Oxytocin + ADH; baaki hormones anterior se'.

qe: Which thyroid hormone is biochemically mandatory for the metamorphosis of tadpoles into adult frogs?
qh: टैडपोल लार्वा को वयस्क मेंढक में बदलने (कायांतरण/Metamorphosis) के लिए कौन सा हार्मोन अनिवार्य है?
e: Concept: Tadpole se frog banne ki process ko 'metamorphosis' kehte hain, jisme tail khatam, taangon ka ubharna aur body ka badalna hota hai - ye sab kuch thyroid ka hormone Thyroxine (T4) ke bina nahi ho sakta. Experiment me agar tadpole ki thyroid nikaal di jaye to wo bada to hota hai par frog nahi banta (gilhari bana rehta hai); ulta thymine/throxine pilane par chhota tadpole bhi jaldi frog ban jata hai. Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Calcitonin (calcium), Insulin (sugar), Adrenaline (emergency). Exam point: 'Metamorphosis ke liye zaroori = Thyroxine (thyroid hormone)'.

qe: Hypercortisolemia characterized by central trunk adiposity, 'Moon Face', and hypertension is clinically diagnosed as:
qh: अधिवृक्क ग्रंथि से कोर्टिसोल हार्मोन के अत्यधिक स्राव से 'मून फेस' और मोटापा होने वाला विकार कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Adrenal cortex se nikle Cortisol ko 'stress hormone' kehte hain jo sugar badhaata hai aur sujan (inflammation) kam karta hai; par jab ye zaroorat se bahut zyada ho jaye (tumor ya dawa se) to khaas lakshan dikhte hain - chehra gol (moon face), peeth/garda me charbi ka dumb (buffalo hump), pet me baigani lines, sirf dhada mota (central obesity), BP aur sugar badhna - ise Cushing's Syndrome kehte hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Conn's (aldosterone - BP + potassium kami), Addison's (cortisol kam - kangalpan, kaala dhabbe), Simmonds' (pituitary ka kaam band). Exam point: 'Cortisol zyada = Cushing's (moon face + buffalo hump); cortisol kam = Addison's'.

qe: Which hypothalamic peptide hormone directly inhibits anterior pituitary Growth Hormone secretion?
qh: पीयूष ग्रंथि से वृद्धि हार्मोन (GH) के स्राव को रोकने वाला हाइपोथैलेमस का हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Hypothalamus ek chhota si jagah hai jo pituitary ke upar baithi brain ka hissa hai aur ye har pituitary hormone ke liye alag 'release' ya 'inhibit' hormone banata hai. Growth Hormone (GH) ke case me do hormone hain: GHRH jaisa wo badhata hai, aur Somatostatin (GHIH) jo use rokta hai (inhibitor). Isi wajah se agar GH zyada bane to doctors Somatostatin-like dawaen use karte hain. Baaki teen releasing/control hormones hain: TRH (thyroid ke liye), GnRH (gonads ke liye), GHRH (GH badhane wala - ulta kaam). Exam point: 'GH ko rokne wala hypothalamic hormone = Somatostatin/GHIH (inhibitory hormone ka classic example)'.

qe: Interstitial Cell Stimulating Hormone (ICSH), which triggers testosterone synthesis in Leydig cells, is identical to:
qh: पुरुषों में वृषण की लेडिग कोशिकाओं को टेस्टोस्टेरोन बनाने के लिए प्रेरित करने वाला ICSH हार्मोन वास्तव में क्या है?
e: Concept: Male me FSH sperm banane ke complex process ko support karta hai aur LH (jo purani kitaabon me ICSH - Interstitial Cell Stimulating Hormone - kehlata hai) testes ke Leydig cells ko testosterone banane ka order deta hai; dono ek hi hormone ke do naam hain. Baaki teen alag pituitary/other hormones hain: ACTH adrenal ke liye, Prolactin doodh banane ke liye, FSH sperm/ova ke liye. Exam point: 'ICSH = LH (Leydig cells ko testosterone banane ka order)'.

qe: Primary adrenocortical insufficiency characterized by fatigue, hypotension, and generalized cutaneous hyperpigmentation is:
qh: एडिसन रोग (Addison's Disease) किस ग्रंथि के हार्मोन स्राव में भारी कमी आने के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Addison's disease me adrenal cortex ki dono paratein (glucocorticoid + mineralocorticoid) kaam karna band kar deti hain - isse cortisol aur aldosterone kam ho jate hain. Iske lakshan hain: thakaan, BP girna (hypotension/chakkar), salt ki talab, wazan kam, aur ek khaas lakshan - chamdi aur muh me gehre (generalized) dhabbe (hyperpigmentation) (ACTH badhne se). Sawal me poochha gaya hai ki kaun sa gland/nissa part iske liye zimmedar hai - wo adrenal cortex (glucocorticoids aur mineralocorticoids) hai. Baaki teen glands kharaab hote to alag bimariyan hoti: Parathyroid (calcium), Pancreatic islets (diabetes), Thyroid (thyroid bimari). Exam point: 'Addison's disease = adrenal cortex ki kami (BP kam + chamdi kaala hona)'.

qe: Thymosin peptide hormones secreted by the thoracic thymus gland are vital for the cell-mediated maturation of:
qh: थाइमस ग्रंथि द्वारा छोड़ा जाने वाला 'थाइमोसिन' हार्मोन किस प्रतिरक्षा कोशिका के परिपक्व होने के लिए आवश्यक है?
e: Concept: Thymus chest me kaleja ke upar ek lymphoid gland hai jo bachpan me sabse zyada sakriya hota hai aur buloogat ke baad sikudne lagta hai. Ye Thymosin hormone banata hai, jo bone marrow se aaye 'immature' cells ko T-lymphocytes banata hai - T-cells wo sainik hain jo virus se paas ko marne aur immune control karte hain, isliye thymus 'immunity ki school' hai. Baaki teen blood cells alag jagah bante hain: RBC bone marrow me, B-lymphocytes (birds/bone marrow) aur platelets bone marrow me. Exam point: 'Thymus = T-lymphocytes ki training/pakad (thymosin se)'; 'B-cells bone marrow me mature hote hain'.

qe: Which mineralocorticoid hormone synthesized in the zona glomerulosa promotes renal sodium reabsorption and potassium excretion?
qh: वृक्क (Kidney) में सोडियम और जल का अवशोषण बढ़ाकर रक्तचाप नियंत्रित करने वाला मुख्य मिनरलोकॉर्टिकॉइड हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Adrenal cortex ki sabse bahari parat (zona glomerulosa) 'mineralocorticoid' Aldosterone banati hai - ye kidney ki naliyon me sodium (Na+) wapas khinchta hai aur potassium (K+) bahar nikalta hai; sodium ke saath paani bhi ruk jata hai, isliye BP banaye rakhne me ye zaroori hai (Aldosterone ke zyada hone par BP + potassium kami - Conn's syndrome). Baaki teen alag hain: Vasopressin paani rokhne ka ADH hai, Cortisol stress/sugar ka, Aur ANF dil se aata hai jo ulta BP ghataata hai. Exam point: 'Sodium bachao-Potassium nikaalo = Aldosterone'.

qe: Benign proliferation of glandular breast tissue in human males resulting from altered estrogen-to-androgen ratios is:
qh: हार्मोनल असंतुलन के कारण पुरुषों में स्तनों के ऊतकों का असामान्य विकास होना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Male me bhi thodi si Estrogen banti hai (testosterone se badalkar); jab ye testosterone ke mukable badh jaye (obesity, liver bimari, kuch dawaen, umar) to mard ke seene ki glandular tissue badh kar chhoti gaddi jaisi ban jati hai - is condition ko Gynaecomastia kehte hain. Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Hirsutism (auraton me baal zyada - puraush hormone zyada), Acromegaly (GH zyada), aur Virilism (aurat me puraush lakshan). Exam point: 'Purush me seene ki sujan/gaddi = Gynaecomastia (estrogen-androgen ka bigadna)'.

qe: Which master diencephalic brain structure governs the pituitary gland through hypophyseal portal neurohormones?
qh: मास्टर ग्रंथि (पीयूष) को नियंत्रित करने वाली 'मास्टर ऑफ मास्टर ग्रंथि' कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Hypothalamus brain ke diencephalon hisse me ek chhota control center hai - ye neend, bhookh, pyaas, temperature aur hormones sab ko sambhalta hai; aur pituitary ke liye 'boss' hai, kyunki ye releasing/inhibiting hormones banata hai jo hypophyseal portal (khaas naliyon) se pituitary tak jaate hain aur use order dete hain. Baaki teen aas-paas ke hisse hain par ye kaam nahi karte: Thalamus (sensation ka relay), Corpus callosum (do hemispheres ka pul), Pineal (melatonin). Exam point: 'Pituitary ka boss = Hypothalamus (releasing hormones se control)'.

qe: Which anterior pituitary lactotrophic hormone is primarily responsible for the synthesis of milk in mammary lobules?
qh: गर्भावस्था के बाद स्तनों में दूध के निर्माण (Milk Production) को उत्तेजित करने वाला हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Mammary glands me doodh 'banane' wala hormone Prolactin hai, jo anterior pituitary (lactotroph cells) se nikalta hai; pregnancy me ye level badhta hai aur delivery ke baad doodh banta hai (aur isliye maa me doodh aata hai). Doodh nikalne (ejection) ka kaam alag hai, wo Oxytocin karta hai. Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Oxytocin (nikalta hai), Progesterone (pregnancy), HCG (pregnancy test). Exam point: 'Doodh banana = Prolactin; doodh nikalna = Oxytocin'.

qe: Which thyroid peptide hormone acts physiologically antagonistic to Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) by lowering blood calcium?
qh: रक्त में कैल्शियम का स्तर कम करने वाला और पैराथायराइड हार्मोन (PTH) के विपरीत कार्य करने वाला थायराइड हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Blood me calcium ka balance do hormones ulta-ulta control karte hain: Parathyroid hormone (PTH) blood ka calcium badhaata hai (haddi se calcium nikaal kar, kidney-aanto me kaam karke); aur Thyroid se nikla Calcitonin blood ka calcium ghataata hai - ye haddi me calcium daba deta hai, isliye ye PTH ka physiological antagonist hai (aur osteoclasts ki activity kam karta hai). Baaki teen calcium ka balance theek se nahi karte: Thymosin (immunity), T4 aur T3 (metabolism). Exam point: 'Calcium badhao = PTH; calcium ghao = Calcitonin'.

qe: Primary hyperaldosteronism presenting with hypertension, hypernatremia, and hypokalemic alkalosis is:
qh: एल्डोस्टेरोन हार्मोन के अत्यधिक स्राव से उच्च रक्तचाप और पोटेशियम की कमी वाला विकार कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Aldosterone zyada ban jaye to (adrenal cortex ke tumor se) sharir me sodium aur paani rukta hai aur potassium nikal jata hai - isse BP badh jata hai (hypertension), blood me sodium zyada (hypernatremia) aur potassium kam (hypokalemia) hokar alkaline mahaul (alkalosis) ban jata hai. Isi set ko Conn's Syndrome (primary hyperaldosteronism) kehte hain. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Graves' (thyroid zyada), Cushing's (cortisol zyada - moon face), Addison's (adrenal kam). Exam point: 'Aldosterone zyada = Conn's (BP badha + potassium kam)'.

qe: Which embryonic syncytiotrophoblast hormone detected in urine strips forms the basis of clinical home pregnancy tests?
qh: घर पर मूत्र परीक्षण (Pregnancy Test) द्वारा गर्भधारण की पुष्टि किस हार्मोन की उपस्थिति से होती है?
e: Concept: Pregnancy ke shuru hone par embryo ke bahari aavran (syncytiotrophoblast) ek hormone banata hai - Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (hCG) - jo embryo ko support karta hai aur itna hi kaam ka hai ki ye maa ke peshab me bhi aata hai. Isliye ghar ke pregnancy test strips hCG hi detect karte hain (2 line aaye to positive). Baaki teen alag hain: Estriol (placenta ka estrogen), LH (ovulation ke liye), Progesterone (pregnancy maintain karta hai par test isi se nahi hoti). Exam point: 'Pregnancy test (urine strip) = hCG hormone'.

qe: The mid-cycle surge of which anterior pituitary gonadotropin directly triggers the rupture of the Graafian follicle (Ovulation)?
qh: मासिक धर्म चक्र के 14वें दिन किस हार्मोन का स्तर अचानक बढ़ने (Surge) से अंडोत्सर्ग (Ovulation) होता है?
e: Concept: Masik chakra ke beech (day 14 ke aas-paas) pituitary se ek achaanak tez Luteinizing Hormone (LH) ka 'surge' hota hai - yahi surge mature Graafian follicle ko phodne ka signal deta hai, jisse egg (ovum) nikal jata hai; isi ko Ovulation kehte hain. Isi wajah se LH kit tests (ovulation predictor) se ovulation ka pata lagta hai aur IVF me LH/hCG injection diye jate hain. Baaki teen alag hain: FSH follicle ko badhata hai (potna nahi), Prolactin doodh ka, Progesterone ovulation ke baad corpus luteum se. Exam point: 'Ovulation trigger = LH surge (mid-cycle)'.

qe: Juvenile-onset Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus is pathologically defined as an autoimmune condition characterized by:
qh: टाइप 1 डायबिटीज (Type 1 Diabetes) का मूल जैविक कारण क्या है?
o: Deficiency of glucagon from alpha cells
Autoimmune destruction of pancreatic islet Beta cells causing absolute insulin deficiency
e: Concept: Type 1 Diabetes (juvenile/insulin-dependent) ek autoimmune bimari hai jisme shareer ki immunity galti se pancreas ke beta cells ko hi maar deti hai; isliye insulin ban-na poori tarah band ho jata hai (absolute deficiency) aur bachche ko insulin injection lagana padta hai. Baaki teen pathophysiologies galat hain: PTH zyada (hyperparathyroidism), peripheral insulin resistance (wo Type 2 hai), aur glucagon ki kami (ye sugar ghataata hai). Exam point: 'Type 1 = beta cells ka autoimmune nash = insulin poori tarah band (injection zaroori)'.

qe: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus predominantly manifests due to which pathophysiology?
qh: टाइप 2 डायबिटीज (Type 2 Diabetes) में मुख्य रूप से क्या खराबी होती है?
o: Peripheral tissue target receptor Insulin Resistance despite ongoing secretion
e: Concept: Type 2 Diabetes zyada umar aur motape wale logon me hoti hai; isme pancreas pehle to insulin banata hai, par body ke cells (muscle, liver, fat) insulin ka jawab dena kam kar dete hain - is condition ko Insulin Resistance kehte hain; shuru me pancreas 'compensate' karta hai (zyada insulin banata hai) par dheere-dheere thak kar insulin kam bhi pad jata hai. Ilaaj kha-paan (diet), exercise aur dawaon se hota hai. Baaki teen galat hain: somatostatin clearance, insulin gene ka na hona (Type 1 type), delta cells ka nash. Exam point: 'Type 2 = Insulin Resistance (insulin banta hai par kaam nahi karta)'.

qe: Which peptide hormone secreted by cardiac atrial myocytes directly opposes the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone axis to lower BP?
qh: हृदय के अलिंद द्वारा उच्च रक्तचाप को कम करने के लिए कौन सा हार्मोन छोड़ा जाता है?
e: Concept: Dil ki atria (upar ke chambers) ke myocytes me bhi endocrine kaam hota hai - jab khoon zyada ho jaye (volume/pressure badhe) to ye Atrial Natriuretic Factor (ANF) hormone chhodte hain; ye kidney se sodium aur paani bahar nikalta hai, aur renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system ko rok deta hai - seedha BP kam ho jata hai. Baaki teen is axis ke doosre parts hain: Renin (kidney), Aldosterone (adrenal), Vasopressin (ADH) - teeno BP paani badhate hain. Exam point: 'Dil se nikla BP ghataane wala hormone = ANF (Atrial Natriuretic Factor)'.

qe: Which steroid hormone secreted by the corpus luteum maintains the secretory endometrium and is considered the 'Pregnancy Hormone'?
qh: गर्भावस्था को बनाए रखने और गर्भपात को रोकने वाला मुख्य हार्मोन कौन सा है जो कॉर्पस ल्यूटियम द्वारा बनता है?
e: Concept: Ovulation ke baad jo toota hua follicle bacha rehta hai wo peeli gathili (Corpus luteum) ban jata hai; ye Progesterone hormone banata hai, jo endometrium (garbhashay ki andar ki parat) ko mota aur khufiya (secretory) banaye rakhta hai, taaki fertilized egg lipat sake. Agar pregnancy na ho to corpus luteum our progesterone gir jate hain aur mensuration hoti hai; pregnancy hone par ye hormone pregnancy maintain karta hai, isliye Progesterone ko 'Pregnancy Hormone' kehte hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Oxytocin delivery ka, FSH follicle ka, Estrogen secondary characters ka. Exam point: 'Corpus luteum se Progesterone = pregnancy hormone (endometrium maintain)'.

qe: Which hormone secreted by the corpus luteum and placenta softens pubic symphysis fibrocartilage during parturition?
qh: प्रसव के समय श्रोणि (Pelvis) के स्नायुओं को शिथिल और चौड़ा करने वाला हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Delivery ke waqt bacche ko pelvic haddiyon ke beech se nikalna hota hai; isliye mature hone par corpus luteum aur placenta ek hormone Relaxin chhodte hain jo pubic symphysis (do pelvi haddiyon ka jod) ke lachakdar cartilage ko naram kar deta hai aur pelvic joints ko dheela karta hai - isse birth canal chaudi hoti hai aur delivery aasan hoti hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Estrogen, Prolactin (doodh), Progesterone (pregnancy maintain). Exam point: 'Pelvic joints dheele karne wala = Relaxin (delivery ke liye)'.

qe: Which anterior mediastinal lymphoid organ involutes progressively following puberty, shrinking significantly in adults?
qh: कौन सी ग्रंथि बचपन में बहुत सक्रिय होती है परंतु यौवन (15 वर्ष) के बाद धीरे-धीरे सिकुड़ जाती है?
e: Concept: Thymus chest ke beech (anterior mediastinum) me kaleja ke upar hota hai; bachpan/childhood me ye sabse bada aur sabse zyada active hota hai (T-cells ko train karta hai), par buloogat ke baad ye dheere-dheere sikudta aur fat se bhar jata hai - is process ko 'involution' kehte hain, isliye bade insaan ka thymus chhota aur kam kaam ka hota hai. Baaki teen organs involution me aate nahi: Pituitary, Thyroid aur Adrenal adult life me bhi sakriya rehte hain. Exam point: 'Buloogat ke baad sikudne wala gland = Thymus (involution; bachpan me immunity ki school)'.

qe: The Pituitary Gland is anatomically lodged and protected within which bony depression of the skull's sphenoid bone?
qh: पीयूष ग्रंथि (पिट्यूटरी) खोपड़ी की स्फेनॉइड हड्डी के किस सुरक्षित गड्ढे में स्थित होती है?
e: Concept: Pituitary ek chhoti si gland hai, isliye ise skull ki sphenoid haddi me ek khaas gaddi (depression) me rakha jata hai jise Sella Turcica (Turkish seat - kursi jaisa) kehte hain; ye use dhachan deta hai aur chot se bachata hai (pituitary tumor me ye gaddi bade hone lag jati hai). Baaki teen skull ke doosre parts hain: Glenoid fossa (kandhe ka jod), Cribriform plate (naak ki haddi), Foramen magnum (spine ka chhed). Exam point: 'Pituitary ki seat = Sella turcica (sphenoid bone me)'.

qe: Which renal glycoprotein hormone stimulates erythrocyte colony-forming units in bone marrow during tissue hypoxia?
qh: गुर्दे (Kidney) द्वारा आरबीसी के निर्माण को उत्तेजित करने वाला कौन सा हार्मोन स्रावित किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Jab sharir ke tissue ko oxygen ki kami (hypoxia) mehsoos hoti hai (high altitude, anaemia, blood loss), kidney ke cells ek hormone Erythropoietin (EPO) chhodte hain; ye bone marrow me jaakar RBC banane wale 'erythrocyte colony-forming units' ko badhkar RBC paida karne ka order deta hai, isliye blood me oxygen dhaane ki kshamta badh jati hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Renin (BP), Angiotensinogen (renin ka target), Calcitriol (calcium). Exam point: 'RBC banane ka hormone = Erythropoietin (kidney se, hypoxia par)'.

qe: Which chronic glucocorticoid synthesized in the adrenal zona fasciculata is popularly termed the primary 'Stress Hormone'?
qh: दीर्घकालिक तनाव और चिंता के समय अधिवृक्क ग्रंथि से निकलने वाला मुख्य 'स्ट्रेस हार्मोन' कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Adrenal cortex ki beech wali parat (zona fasciculata) glucocorticoid Cortisol banati hai; ye sharir ka mukhya 'Stress Hormone' hai - kisi bhi stress (bimari, chot, bhookh, darr) par cortisol sugar badhaata hai, protein-fat ko toota hai (energy ke liye), aur inflammation-allergy dabata hai; ye protein-food ko glucose me badalne me bhi madad karta hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Adrenaline sirf emergency ke seconds ka hormone hai, Melatonin neend ka, Thyroxine metabolism ka. Exam point: 'Chronic stress hormone = Cortisol (adrenal cortex se)'; 'emergency = adrenaline'.

qe: The '4S' clinical functions of the adrenal cortex stand for Sugar, Salt, Stress, and:
qh: एड्रिनल ग्रंथि के '4S' कार्यों में शुगर, साल्ट, स्ट्रेस और चौथा 'S' किसका प्रतीक है?
e: Concept: Adrenal cortex ke kaam ko chaar 'S' se yaad rakhte hain: Sugar (cortisol blood sugar badhaata hai), Salt (aldosterone sodium-paani sambhalta hai), Stress (cortisol stress se ladta hai) aur Sex (androgens/estrogen, secondary sexual characters aur sex drive). Isi wajah se adrenal gland ki kami se chaaron cheezein bigad jati hain. Baaki teen 'S' is list ka hissa nahi hain: Sight, Saliva aur Sleep. Exam point: 'Adrenal cortex ke 4S = Sugar, Salt, Stress, Sex'.

qe: Which endocrine gland operates independently of the pituitary gland's hypothalamic-pituitary-end organ axis?
qh: कौन सी अंतःस्रावी ग्रंथि मास्टर ग्रंथि (पीयूष) के नियंत्रण में नहीं आती और रक्त में कैल्शियम के अनुसार सीधे काम करती है?
e: Concept: Baaki saari endocrine glands pituitary (aur hypothalamus) ke order par chalti hain, par ek gland apna control khud karta hai - Parathyroid gland. Ye blood me calcium ke level par seedha react karta hai: calcium kam hua to PTH chhod deta hai (haddi se calcium chhudakar blood me daalta hai) aur calcium zyada to PTH band (aisa feedback direct calcium se hota hai, pituitary se nahi). Baaki teen pituitary ke control me hain: Gonads (FSH/LH), Thyroid (TSH), Adrenal cortex (ACTH). Exam point: 'Pituitary se aazad gland = Parathyroid (sirf calcium se control)'.

qe: How many pea-sized parathyroid glands are embedded on the posterior lobes of the human thyroid gland?
qh: थायराइड ग्रंथि के पीछे मटर के दाने के आकार की कुल कितनी पैराथायराइड ग्रंथियां जुड़ी होती हैं?
e: Concept: Thyroid gland ke peeche ki taraf chaar chhoti-chhoti pea jaisi glands lagti hain - Parathyroid glands (2 upar, 2 neeche) - ye Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) banati hain jo blood me calcium aur phosphate ka balance sambhalti hai; agar ye galti se thyroid surgery me nikal jayein to calcium gir jata hai (muh-chamdi me jhunjhuni, muscle akadan - tetany). Baaki teen counts galat hain (6, 2, 1) - insaan me chaar hote hain. Exam point: 'Parathyroid glands = 4 (thyroid ke peeche, PTH for calcium)'.

qe: What is the structural and physiological difference between an Endocrine gland and an Exocrine gland?
qh: अंतःस्रावी (Endocrine) और बहिःस्रावी (Exocrine) ग्रंथियों में मुख्य अंतर क्या होता है?
o: Endocrine are ductless and secrete hormones into blood; Exocrine possess ducts for enzymes
Endocrine only exist in the brain
Endocrine have long ducts, Exocrine are ductless
e: Concept: Glands do tarah ki hoti hain. Exocrine glands (sweat, salivary, pancreas ka enzyme wala hissa) me duct (nali) hoti hai jisse unka padarth bahar ya kisi nali me jaata hai. Endocrine glands (ductless) me koi nali nahi hoti - ye apne hormones seedha khoon (blood) me chhodti hain, jisse hormone poore sharir me pahunchta hai. Baaki teen statements galat hain: exocrine sirf waste nahi chhodti (enzymes bhi), endocrine sirf brain me nahi (poore sharir me - adrenal, thyroid), aur ducts ka ulta hai. Exam point: 'Endocrine = ductless, seedha blood me; Exocrine = nali wali, enzymes/bahar'.

qe: Which butterfly or H-shaped bilobed endocrine gland wraps around the anterior surface of the human trachea?
qh: मानव श्वासनली (Trachea) के ऊपर स्थित तितली या 'H-आकार' की ग्रंथि कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Thyroid gland gale me trachea (saans ki nali) ke aage-chipak kar ek pitali (BUTTERFLY) ya H ke aakar me hoti hai - do lob (bayen-dayen) aur ek beech ka jhod (isthmus). Yahi khaas shakal hi 'butterfly/H-shaped' naam ka kaaran hai, aur yahi ise gale me sahara deti hai. Baaki teen glands ye shakal nahi rakhti: Thymus chest me, Submandibular jabda ke neeche, Adrenal kidney par. Exam point: 'Trachea ke aage butterfly/H-shaped gland = Thyroid (T3, T4, calcitonin)'.

qe: Which endocrine structure in the brain is often referred to as the 'Third Eye' due to its light-sensitive neuroendocrine role?
qh: प्रकाश संवेदनशीलता और जैविक लय के कारण मस्तिष्क की किस ग्रंथि को 'तीसरी आँख' कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Agni/Pineal gland. Pineal gland brain ke andar ek chhoti shankaar (pine cone) jaisi structure hai jise purane log 'Third Eye' (teesri aankh) kehte the, kyunki ye roshni ke signal (retina se) par melatonin banaati hai - andhere me zyada. Ye body ki ghadi (circadian rhythm) aur neend-jaagne ke cycle ka control karti hai. Baaki teen brain ke hisse hain: Thalamus sensation relay, Pituitary master gland, Hypothalamus control center. Exam point: "Pineal gland = 'third eye' (melatonin aur biological clock)".

qe: Which endocrine gland is anatomically considered the smallest in the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर में आकार और भार की दृष्टि से सबसे छोटी अंतःस्रावी ग्रंथि कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Insaan ki sabse chhoti endocrine gland Pineal gland hai - ye lagbhag 0.1 gram ki chhoti seed jaisi hai aur brain ke andar hoti hai (pituitary, adrenal aur thyroid isse bade hote hain). Ye itni chhoti hone par bhi neend (melatonin) ka important kaam karti hai. Baaki teen glands size me bade hain: Pituitary (small par pineal se bada), Adrenal, Thyroid. Exam point: 'Sabse chhoti endocrine gland = Pineal gland (~0.1 gram)'.
